name: Azman bin Hassan
bio:
Azman's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track but in the engineering workshops of Kuala Lumpur. His fascination with vehicle dynamics and relentless pursuit of perfection led him to excel in mechanical engineering. After completing his degree, he joined Proton as a junior engineer, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and ability to troubleshoot complex problems.

His transition to motorsports came when Team WRT scouted him for his technical expertise. Initially hesitant, Azman found himself captivated by the high-stakes environment and the relentless pursuit of marginal gains. As a sporting director, Azman emphasizes meticulous preparation, believing that a well-executed strategy minimizes the impact of unforeseen circumstances. His hands-on approach and deep understanding of vehicle mechanics distinguish him from other sporting directors who primarily focus on management.

Azman's eye for detail is renowned, and he is known to spend hours poring over telemetry data, searching for subtle improvements. He fosters a data-driven culture within his team, encouraging engineers to question assumptions and explore innovative solutions. His ambition is to lead Team WRT to unprecedented success, blending technical prowess with strategic acumen.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with slight graying at the temples
physical.description: A lean man with a focused gaze, Azman carries himself with quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a particular fondness for strong, sweet Malaysian coffee and drinks at least three cups a day.
Insists on personally inspecting the car setup before every race, even if it means getting his hands dirty.
